serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: The place that Annalie invited us to. We went there before, right?
You: Yeah, I think so.
It’s that expensive place again…{{wi}} thanks, Annalie…
Bot: Do you remember what you got the last time?
You: No, not really.
Bot: Should I remind you so that you won’t get the same thing twice?
You: I think they have a brunch menu, so that shouldn’t be a problem.
Bot: You are pretty knowledgeable about this stuff.
You: I learned about this from movies. To be honest, I have never been to a brunch in my life.
#bot.Expression.blush
Bot: Another of your first times will be mine then!
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
You: C-Come on now, that’s something a creepy old man would say.
Bot: Like Mr. Landlord?
You: Yeah.
